events.name: Will Dempsey
events.info: Will Dempsey didnt take the easy road to music. He took the responsible one. For almost 15 years, he worked in the chemical plant industry while the dream hed carried since childhood sat quietly in the back of his mind. He thought hed retire there.Then a video of him and his son went viral. A dad and his kid, an unguarded moment that reached millions of people. Hed spent 15 years setting the dream aside turns out, the dream wasnt done with him.The music comes straight out of real life. Alarm clocks and overtime. A love that costs you something. The pride and heartache of raising kids. The grief that doesnt follow a timeline. He writes about those things because hes lived them, not as metaphor, but as memory.Hell tell you hes just a regular guy who took the long way to get here. And every mile of it ended up in the music.special guest: GAVIN HUGHES

events.name: Edgar Sandoval
events.info: Edgar Sandoval is living proof that bad decisions make great comedy.Born and raised on the east side of Milwaukee, Edgar spent years as a television news anchor before realizing that reporting on other peoples problems wasnt nearly as funny as talking about his own. Now an internationally touring stand-up comedian, he mines endless material from a 27-year marriage, four children, and the unique experience of being a second-generation Asian American.Somehow, hes managed to stay married for nearly three decades, keep four kids alive, and convince audiences across the country to laugh at his questionable life choices. Edgar has headlined in Las Vegas and throughout Wisconsin and Illinois, and has opened on the road for Charlie Berens, Chris Kattan, April Macie, Liz Miele, Ryan Niemiller, Erica Rhodes, and many others.You might have seen him perform at the Improv, The Laughing Tap or ODonoghues or back in the day at Kopps, The Coffee Trader, Sentry on Downer and Oakland, or overnights on Channel 12.

generalInfo.generalRule: For more information including door times, show times, support acts and other FAQs please visit https://www.landmarkculive.com/ Live Nation is committed to providing a safe and secure environment for our guests to enjoy their visit to our venues. We encourage you to review our safety and security information below prior to arrival at the venue. • Please arrive early to the venue to allow enough time for you and your guests to move through the queue and enter the venue. • Prior to entering the venue, guests will be searched (wand or walk through metal detection and/or pat downs) to ensure that none of the restricted items enters the building. • We suggest you leave valuable and unnecessary items at home. • You may be asked to empty your pockets of all items so that they can be examined. • All alcohol and narcotic laws will be strictly enforced. • All bags will be searched, no large bags or backpacks will be allowed. Restricted Items: (Keep in mind priority number 1 is to HAVE FUN! Just please do it without the items listed below) • No guns, knives, weapons, pepper spray, projectiles of any kind, or any other item that could be used to inflict harm. • Replicas of any type of weapon are not permitted • No drugs, drug paraphernalia or illegal substances of any kind • No outside food or drinks • No personal video cameras, Go-Pros, selfie sticks, drones, masks or laser pointers. • No professional audio, video, or audio recording equipment - (including detachable lenses, tripods, zooms or commercial use rigs) • No unsealed liquids or gels of any kind • No jewelry or clothing that could inflict harm • No large bags over (12x6x12), backpacks, Camelbacks or Bota bags • No stuffed animals or toys of any kind • This list of prohibited items is subject to change at the discretion of venue management Zero Tolerance for Drug Use or Possession • The use or possession of any illegal drugs will not be tolerated anywhere inside or outside the venue. Security personnel and narcotics officers will be working and enforcing all drug-related laws. Do not bring any illegal substances to the event as violators will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law. If you are found impaired at the door, security will not allow you to enter the venue. Event staff reserves the right to refuse entry to anyone. Please come with a smile and be prepared to enjoy a fun filled night of music and dancing. Safety and Medical • Live Nation is dedicated to providing a safe environment. Public and private security will be present throughout the entire event. The Security Staff will be available to assist your needs including any medical requests.

events.info: She lives fast, loves freely, and throws a better party than anyone in Paris. But beneath the champagne and charm, Violetta knows her days in the spotlight will not last forever. When she dares to trade pleasure for true love, society is quick to remind her just how unforgiving Paris can be. La Traviata is all romance, sacrifice, and a story where happily ever after takes a hard pass. events.name: Roger Clyne and The Peacemakers
events.info: Heres to life! Fans around the world can be found singing the chorus of the Roger Clyne-penned fan favorite Mekong and toasting their glasses in unison to celebrate life through rock-n-roll. But the inspiration for the song dates back to the time Roger went to Taipei, Taiwan, as a college student to teach English during the day and busk with his guitar at night for money.Today, as Clyne prepares to release his 11th studio album, he continues to transform his life experiences, inspirations, observations and his own muses into timeless music. And whether hes wearing his Converse high tops, boots or sandals, Clynes blend of punk rock, americana, indie-pop and mariachi influences have made him, drummer PH Naffah, guitarist Jim Dalton and bassist Nick Scropos collectively known as Roger Clyne one of Americas best live rock-n-roll bands.Starting with the seminal Tempe quartet, The Refreshments, Clyne and Naffah put the fun in rock . more
